title: Something_Big_Is_Happening
summary:
"Something Big Is Happening" is an essay by Matt Shumer, an AI entrepreneur, about the impact of artificial intelligence, published in February 2026. The essay has reportedly been viewed more than 80 million times and became widely discussed across media and social platforms.

Shumer is the CEO of HyperWrite and co-founder of OthersideAI. He published the 5,000-word essay as a personal note for non-tech friends and family. His central claim is that AI capability is accelerating so rapidly that large-scale displacement of white-collar work is imminent, perhaps within one to five years. He noted that the technology has crossed an important threshold where AI has become capable of creating self-improving systems.

Speaking to CNBC's Power Lunch, Shumer said that his core message is that people in the workforce should start to use and experiment with AI tools so they can understand what is coming. The essay sparked a broad public conversation about AI's impact on the workforce and society.

The essay also elicited significant criticism. Paulo Carvao, writing in Forbes Magazine, stated that while some of his advice is sound, it reads at times like a sales pitch. Writing in The Guardian, Dan Milmo and Aisha Down mentioned Shumer as having a history of AI hype, stating he previously excited the internet by announcing the release of the world's top open-source model, which it was not. Mashable captured skeptical perspectives with a piece headlined "The AI industry has a big Chicken Little problem." Many workers in the technology sector criticized the article in blog posts shared on Hacker News.
